title: Simon 7.3.3(1): integer densities outside a set E with μH[n−3+α](E) = 0 (n ≥ 1)
statement: For all n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and n ≥ 1, all sets U, N ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} and every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U): if U is open, N is an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N), (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, T is minimizing in U ∩ N (IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N)), spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T), then there is a set E ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with μH[n − 3 + α](E) = 0 for every real α > 0 such that for every x ∈ U ∖ E there is an integer m with HasMassDensity T x m (Θ^n(μ_T, x) = m).
lean_statement: ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∃ E : Set (Euclid (n + k)), (∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → μH[(n : ℝ) - 3 + α] E = 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ U \ E, ∃ m : ℤ, HasMassDensity T x m
